# Castingwords

CastingWords offers high-quality, human-powered transcription services with a RESTful API for seamless integration into various workflows.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/castingwords/.

## Actions

- **Cancel and Refund Audio File**: Cancel an ordered audio file and issue a refund if applicable.
- **Get Prepay Balance** (read-only): Retrieve the current prepay balance for the account.
- **Get registered webhook URL** (read-only): Retrieve the currently registered webhook url for account notifications.
- **List Available SKUs** (read-only): Retrieve list of available skus.
- **Order Transcript**: Create a new transcription order for audio/video at a url.
- **Order Upgrades**: Order an upgrade for a specific audio file.
- **Register Webhook**: Register a webhook url to receive transcript completion notifications.
- **Test Webhook Call**: Request a test webhook call for a specific event type.
